title: News Consumption 2026
discussion_signal: Ofcom describes news discovery as increasingly fragmented across social platforms, creators, influencers, and AI while established providers retain trust and civic seriousness for many audiences.
linked_research_question: How does intermediary-led news discovery change trust and civic seriousness when audiences still return to established providers?
limits: The post summarizes Ofcom research without providing the full survey tables
Reported discovery patterns do not establish political effects
UK findings may not generalize to other media systems
